result.stdout:
Description:
  Dnui runtime: a cached Avalonia host driven by commands.

Usage:
  Dnui.Runtime [command] [options]

Options:
  --app-assembly <app-assembly>  Path to a .NET assembly containing the app type.
  --app-type <app-type>          Full name of a type deriving from Dnui.DnuiApp, resolved in --app-assembly.
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
  --version                      Show version information

Commands:
  tray                                Show one system tray icon controlled by JSON-RPC over stdio.
  window <assembly-path> <type-name>  Show a Dnui.DnuiWindow from an assembly and resolve its result.
  dialog                              Show a built-in dialog and resolve the chosen path(s).

Description:
  Show a Dnui.DnuiWindow from an assembly and resolve its result.

Usage:
  Dnui.Runtime window <assembly-path> <type-name> [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly-path>  IL assembly containing the window type.
  <type-name>      Full name of a Dnui.DnuiWindow subclass.

Options:
  --headless                         Avalonia headless platform: no display.
  --dialog-outcome <dialog-outcome>  Headless only, repeatable: outcomes for the window's dialogs, in order.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
  --app-assembly <app-assembly>      Path to a .NET assembly containing the app type.
  --app-type <app-type>              Full name of a type deriving from Dnui.DnuiApp, resolved in --app-assembly.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Choose one or more files to open.

Usage:
  Dnui.Runtime dialog open-file [options]

Options:
  --title <title>                Dialog title.
  --start-folder <start-folder>  Initial folder (ignored if missing).
  --multiple                     Allow selecting more than one item.
  --filter <filter>              File-type filter Name:pattern,pattern (repeatable).
  --headless                     Show nothing; resolve --outcome.
  --outcome <outcome>            Headless only: the result JSON to resolve.
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
  --app-assembly <app-assembly>  Path to a .NET assembly containing the app type.
  --app-type <app-type>          Full name of a type deriving from Dnui.DnuiApp, resolved in --app-assembly.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Choose where to save a file.

Usage:
  Dnui.Runtime dialog save-file [options]

Options:
  --title <title>                          Dialog title.
  --start-folder <start-folder>            Initial folder (ignored if missing).
  --filter <filter>                        File-type filter Name:pattern,pattern (repeatable).
  --suggested-name <suggested-name>        Prefilled file name.
  --default-extension <default-extension>  Extension appended when none is typed.
  --no-overwrite-prompt                    Don't ask before choosing an existing file.
  --headless                               Show nothing; resolve --outcome.
  --outcome <outcome>                      Headless only: the result JSON to resolve.
  -?, -h, --help                           Show help and usage information
  --app-assembly <app-assembly>            Path to a .NET assembly containing the app type.
  --app-type <app-type>                    Full name of a type deriving from Dnui.DnuiApp, resolved in --app-assembly.
